children: Gyre made an updated corporate presentation public highlighting its China-enabled R&D engine, upcoming IND plans and F351 regulatory progress.
Updated corporate presentation furnished as Exhibit 99.1 and posted to Gyre’s website under Regulation FD disclosure.
Company emphasizes integrated U.S.–China R&D model to fund and accelerate degrader and DAC programs via China commercial cash flow.
Multiple programs targeting IND submissions in Q1 2027, including CG923308 (CDK2/Cyclin E) and CG620953 (TYK2/JAK1).
F351 NDA accepted by China NMPA in May 2026; Phase 3 met primary endpoint with 52.85% vs 29.84% ≥1-stage fibrosis regression (p=0.0002).
CG001419 Pan-TRK degrader completed Phase 1 with target engagement and favorable tolerability; Phase 2 planning for cancer-induced bone pain.
